target_user: Manual/low-code QA testers, developers and citizen testers; teams seeking recorder plus BrowserStack browser/device cloud
distinctive_features: Chrome recorder yields editable plain-English steps, iframe/Shadow DOM capture, element/text/visual validations, reusable Modules with variable overrides/history, CSV/database datasets, local replay and cloud multi-browser/mobile-browser suites. Video/screenshots/console/HAR/network reports and schedules/CI. Local dataset replay uses first selected row; modules cannot nest. AI/self-healing marketed, governance depth unclear.
public_pricing: Free entry advertised with no numeric quota. Paid Essentials/Pro/Ultimate/Enterprise Contact Sales. Search snippets with $12.50 annual equivalent/$19 monthly are ambiguous and cannot be attributed to Low Code.
pricing_unit: Paid unit for Low Code not publicly established; no per-user/workspace/test/minute/concurrency rate verified.
billing_terms_quotas_addons: Paid tiers feature-gated: Essentials includes scheduling/data/cross-browser/CI; Pro mobile-browser/database/five parallels/AI agents; higher tiers accessibility/Percy and enterprise controls. Billing cadence, free quotas, overage, add-ons and paid price unverified.
pricing_evidence_status: Current official page and docs reviewed 2026-10-06; apparent search-card price deliberately not attributed.
local_execution_ai_privacy_governance: Local record/replay and cloud suite execution; local does not prove offline/private AI. BrowserStack cloud supports localhost/private websites. AI processing location, retention, customer keys and offline inference unverified. Complete portable export/self-hosted runner not established.
moat_strength_inference: Moderate-to-strong parent distribution/infrastructure inference; moderate workflow switching; Low Code AI/data moat emerging/unproven.
moat_mechanism_and_limits: Parent browser/device cloud and existing ecosystem are meaningful operating/distribution assets; modules, datasets, baselines, run history and schedules create switching costs. No independent product-specific AI reliability or exclusive learned corpus.
veyra_implication: Major direct threat to generic recorder+AI; Veyra can focus on truly local semantic layer and results but must show buyers trade off BrowserStack breadth.

category: Cloud no-code and AI-assisted web/mobile/API testing
product_status: Active SmartBear product; acquired by SmartBear 2024
target_user: Functional/manual QA teams, developers and organizations seeking cloud E2E without Selenium framework ownership
distinctive_features: Hybrid recorder, free-form AI Prompt Steps for actions/assertions/questions, AI fallback using expected text/step descriptions, deterministic and Boolean AI oracles, reusable parameterized Segments (no nesting), variables/secrets, video/console/network evidence, CI/API execution, and web/mobile/API/visual/email/SMS scope. Prompt limitations include uploads/downloads, drag/drop/swipes and native alerts.
public_pricing: 14-day unlimited-functionality free trial. Premium, Advanced and Enterprise quote-only; no numeric currency price.
pricing_unit: Run credits: Web 1, standalone API 0.1, native Mobile 5. Users/test cases unlimited. Web parallelism is 3/4/5 by tier.
billing_terms_quotas_addons: Monthly credits Premium 5,000; Advanced 20,000; Enterprise 40,000. Mobile parallel testing is add-on; Enterprise private environments. AI usage described as unlimited. Overage price, credit add-on, rollover, annual/monthly terms, minimum contract undisclosed.
pricing_evidence_status: Official SmartBear pricing and docs current; no older third-party price used.
local_execution_ai_privacy_governance: Cloud-executed; local app exposed via ngrok and private environments via encrypted tunnel. LLM docs identify OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic with provider prompt processing; no offline inference, customer-hosted model or no-retention guarantee established.
moat_strength_inference: Moderate but unproven: SmartBear distribution/ecosystem, workflow switching and cloud operations; learned artifacts emerging/unverified.
moat_mechanism_and_limits: Segments, parameters, secrets, suites, histories, CI integrations and cloud AI routing create practical costs. No cross-customer learning, ABM or repair accuracy evidence.
veyra_implication: Explicit assertions, modules and prompt actions are not differentiators alone. Veyra may offer local execution and semantic provenance but must validate boundary and need.

category: AI-native application QA and agentic web/mobile testing
product_status: Active current product; current tiers quote-based; no successor/rebrand identified
target_user: Engineering/product and QA teams shipping frequently with reachable staging environments and CI/CD, less aligned to standalone local manual testers
distinctive_features: Natural-language goal and expected result; visual agents/crawling/knowledge graph; dynamic PR testing distinguishes pre-existing from introduced failures and can return unverified when change was not exercised; authored tests remain drafts until activated; video/screenshots/traces/console/network/issue evidence; rules/configs/dependencies. Cloud execution, Chromium web, local tunnels; docs warn config data stored unencrypted and passed to model.
public_pricing: Starter, Growth and Enterprise quote-based; no public numerical price/currency; POC sales-led, no confirmed free trial.
pricing_unit: Commercial dimensions users, environments, parallel runs and executions under undefined fair-use; no published charge unit/price.
billing_terms_quotas_addons: Starter 1 user, 3 parallels, 2 environments; Growth up to 5 users/custom parallels and environments; Enterprise custom users/parallels/unlimited environments. Creation/chat/maintenance included, executions count under fair use. Starter 30-day retention; Growth 90-day; Enterprise custom. Monthly/annual terms, included quota, overages and rate undisclosed.
pricing_evidence_status: Official current pricing reviewed; older third-party monthly prices contradicted and excluded.
local_execution_ai_privacy_governance: Agents/runners operate in cloud; CLI tunnel reaches local ports but is not local execution or private AI. Enterprise SSH/private network. SOC2 Type 2/no model training are vendor claims; docs warn configs stored unencrypted and passed to model. Draft/activate governance documented, active-test repair approval unclear.
moat_strength_inference: Emerging-to-moderate overall; moderate switching costs, learned context emerging, cloud infrastructure emerging; no independent reliability/model moat.
moat_mechanism_and_limits: Knowledge graph, rules, configs, dependencies, revisions, history and CI/ticket workflows can create switching cost; portability/export claims conflict and no longitudinal learning benchmark.
veyra_implication: Goal, graph, diagnostics and unverified verdict are adjacent to ABM. Veyra must distinguish approved typed behavior, local-first operation and user persona, not claim uncontested AI QA.
